question: On the consumed fresh SceneNN cohort, can target-plane rectification restore RoMa true-pair support without relaxing any matcher or absolute-support threshold?

predecessor.failure_signature: TF02 had high directional cycle coverage but only 0.35-0.39 purity, while edge-clipped TF03 had approximately one-percent cycle support.
predecessor.single_change: Rectify each truth-visible target proposal independently to its own complete target-mesh PCA plane and count cycle evidence only on rectified target-visible pixels; keep every RoMa weight, resolution, certainty, cycle-error, support fraction, assignment, scenario and target unchanged.

literature_basis.title: Single-Image Depth Prediction Makes Feature Matching Easier
literature_basis.used_for: Perspective rectification of planar regions before off-the-shelf feature matching.

literature_basis.title: GPVK-VL: Geometry-Preserving Virtual Keyframes for Visual Localization under Large Viewpoint Changes
literature_basis.used_for: Geometry-preserving virtual views to reduce viewpoint gaps before feature matching.

literature_basis.title: InLoc: Indoor Visual Localization with Dense Matching and View Synthesis
literature_basis.used_for: Dense matching plus synthesized-view verification in low-texture, repetitive indoor scenes.

rectification.plane_source: All provider target-instance mesh vertices; no RGB score or matcher output enters plane fitting.
rectification.plane_fit: SVD/PCA of centered target vertices; the two dominant right-singular vectors span the plane.
rectification.axis_rule: The larger exact target-mesh planar extent is vertical; each axis sign is fixed by its largest-magnitude world component.
rectification.extent_rule: Exact minimum and maximum target-vertex coordinates on the two plane axes; no percentile, padding or fitted crop.
rectification.warp: One source-to-fronto-parallel homography with bilinear RGB and nearest-neighbour target-visible mask.
rectification.invalid_fill: Per-view mean BGR over rectified target-visible pixels.
rectification.support_domain: Directional cycle fraction denominator is the source rectified target-visible pixel count; forward matches must land on target-visible pixels.

renderer.near_plane_face_rule: reject unless every vertex is beyond near plane
renderer.visibility_rule: target depth finite and no farther than full-scene depth plus 0.005 m

matcher.rank_score: unchanged geometric mean of directional cycle-consistent fractions
matcher.zero_assignment: unchanged strict reciprocal maximum among supported pairs

baseline.model: unchanged local DINOv2-S evaluated on the same rectified views

forbidden_after_freeze: change target plane, axes, extent, output size, fill, validity domain, matcher, threshold, assignment, scenarios or gate
claim freshness or confirmation authority from this consumed posthoc replay
drop TF02, TF03, any different-target pair, or any failed scenario
claim_boundary: This is consumed posthoc Development evidence for privileged target-plane viewpoint normalization and visibility-aware cycle support only. It does not prove raw-phone target detection, phone-side geometry, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, deployment, or safety.
